parsed.reply: Yes, «бездонный» works very well for the figurative sense («an abyssal darkness»), capturing the idea of a bottomless void. For the literal oceanographic sense, however, it is better translated as «абиссальный» or «глубоководный», since «бездонный» sounds too poetic or metaphorical for marine biology.
followUps: One more example for the ocean sense
